text:
Pearls are typically found in oysters, clams, and mussels.

Adapting elements from the hip-hop genre to enrich the artistic concept of pearls:

Imagine pearls not just as serene orbs, but as the crystallized essence of urban rhythm. Their luster mirrors the neon glow of city streets at night, while their formation within the rough, gritty shell of an oyster parallels the raw, authentic beats of hip-hop. The layered nacre represents the complex lyrical flow, each layer a verse building depth and resilience. The pearl’s smooth surface reflects the polished final product of artistic expression, emerging from the turbulent, rhythmic currents of urban life, embodying both the struggle and the beauty found in the relentless pace of the city.
